name: Recorded Future Triage (tria.ge)
tier_rationale: Recorded Future, Inc. (Hatching Triage), an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P177 and P180 'trusted - tria.ge (Hatching / Recorded Future)'.

reliability.justification: Sandbox analysis reports with extracted malware configurations; family labels are vendor signatures, one vote per adapter (P177).

triage.description: Recorded Future Triage API key (Authorization: Bearer header)
triage.plan_hint: free Individual/Researcher licences are non-commercial and publish analyses; corporate use needs a commercial Triage licence recorded in licence_allow (P177)

search_api.title: Triage API v0 search (sha256, family, tag, url queries)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor, verified 2026-11-26): Triage's free Individual/Researcher licences are non-commercial and make analyses public, so corporate use needs a commercial Triage licence

search_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P177 cond 3). tria.ge/api/v0/search?query=sha256:|family:|tag:|url: with the Bearer key (research C0411); search/metadata only: no sample download or submission endpoint is ever built (P177). evidence_url checked 2026-11-26: the Individual plan lists 'Public analysis results' and 'Non-commercial use'; Researcher adds API access. Success fixture required before merge (P177).
search_api.licensed_alternative: A commercial Triage licence recorded in licence_allow (the 'license' path, P177); the manual report search links (triage.report_pages) stay available.

report_pages.title: Triage report search pages /s?q= and /reports?q= (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Search pages only: no template points to a submission or upload endpoint (rule 7); V3LUM never downloads samples or reports from Triage.

report_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P180 cond 9). Class 'open' is the P180 chair-file class for manual links. tria.ge/s?q={hash} (redirects to /reports?q=) for md5/sha1/sha256; the family search q=family:{q} stays verified=false until checked in a browser (P180, research C0423).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G14-1, p3-G07-2: batches only extend it (triage__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Flags all false: no submission path exists (free plans publish analyses; same rule as P066). One module per provider (triage inside hash_lookup_keyed), default off, Bearer header (P177). No quota block: daily budgets via P334 once the licence's figures are recorded.
